# Care technology for  people who care

Helping to safeguard vulnerable people, even when you cannot always be there!

[Interested in how Carezapp can support your organisation? Let's Talk >>](https://carezapp.com/contact/)

![](https://carezapp.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/home-header-image.png)

![](https://carezapp.com/wp-content/themes/carezapp/assets/images/hero-chevrons.svg)

## Amongst all the challenges, it’s people who care!

Care providers and partner organisations deliver better support for frontline staff, enhance quality face-to-face care and support, and enable proactive care monitoring day and night by incorporating Carezapp. Whilst delivering significant cost efficiencies through enhanced care and support services.

[Key benefits realised through Carezapp >>](https://carezapp.com/why-carezapp/)

![](https://carezapp.com/wp-content/themes/carezapp/assets/images/bubble-blue-green.svg)![](https://carezapp.com/wp-content/themes/carezapp/assets/images/bubble-purple.svg)![](https://carezapp.com/wp-content/themes/carezapp/assets/images/bubble-yellow.svg)![](https://carezapp.com/wp-content/themes/carezapp/assets/images/bubble-blue.svg)![](https://carezapp.com/wp-content/themes/carezapp/assets/images/bubble-primary.svg)

![](https://carezapp.com/wp-content/themes/carezapp/assets/images/bubble-group.svg)

## Helping vulnerable people to flourish!

Carezapp is a care technology platform for people delivering care and support in homes and other social care settings. Carezapp connects and informs people who care through technology and data that delivers real-time information, empowers them and provides peace of mind. Safeguarding through care technology enhances independence, safety and wellbeing.

[How Carezapp works >>](https://carezapp.com/how-it-works/)
